description: Blind contract cases over the 12 ecommerce failure scenarios. GENERATED by scripts using evals.rca_truth.rca_input_from_truth — do not hand-edit inputs; regenerate instead, so the blindness assertion runs over every input. run() suppresses all retrieval (offline=True), so these cases are deterministic: with no telemetry, the confidence cap and the status derivation force INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE whatever the model proposes — the same result on a laptop with a live cluster as in CI with neither. Root-cause accuracy against telemetry is measured by evals/rca_eval.py; the HITL and action-grounding contracts by tests/test_rca_fallback_honesty.py.

cases.description: RCA receives only the EcommerceOrderErrorRateHigh alert as an RA-001 verdict for order-service, with retrieval suppressed (run() runs offline).
